title: ORBITAL — Make a cosmic detour
description: An original responsive planetary playground with animated Three.js worlds, direct scene selection, camera orbit and zoom, pause/resume, time warp, reset, and a readable WebGL-unavailable fallback.

tests.name: Local Vite in-memory bundle
tests.command: node --input-type=module -e "import {build} from 'vite'; import path from 'node:path'; const root=path.resolve('experiments/planetary/luna-medium-bold'); const result=await build({configFile:false,root,logLevel:'warn',build:{write:false,emptyOutDir:false,cssCodeSplit:false}}); console.log(Array.isArray(result)?result.map(x=>x.output.length):result.output.length)"
tests.outcome: passed; Vite produced 3 in-memory bundle chunks; build.write was false

tests.name: HTML module entry contract
tests.command: Python count of the exact required module script tag and all script tags in index.html
tests.outcome: passed; exact required tag appears once and is the only script tag

repairsMade: Added the missing play-icon element ID referenced by the playback control and aligned its aria-pressed state with the running state.
Removed an empty CSS import declaration to keep the implementation fully self-contained.

The first exploratory Vite invocation incorrectly supplied the repository-level index.html as an explicit Rollup input and failed to resolve its /src/main.js. Reran the check using the assigned run directory as Vite root and its default index discovery; the local bundle passed. No application source change was needed for that invocation correction.
knownLimitations: Browser rendering and interaction could not be tested because localhost browser access is unavailable in this environment.
Actual WebGL-unavailable behavior is implemented as an error fallback but was not exercised in a browser.
